_note: Ops board launch targets (operator ask 2026-09-15: 'add on opsboard a trigger to run the Claude app in the pc'). The board is a scheduled task with a 5-minute self-healing trigger, so it stays up when the Claude desktop app does not - which makes it the one thing on the PC a phone can still reach. THE REQUEST NEVER CARRIES A PATH OR A COMMAND: /api/launch takes a target NAME from this file and nothing else, because the board binds 0.0.0.0 on the LAN with no authentication and an endpoint that ran what it was told would be a remote shell on the house network. Add a target by adding a row here; a row whose candidates all miss is reported as not-found with every path it tried, never guessed at. S310 (operator: 'they dont do anything when i click them'): the board is an S4U task in session 0, so a GUI it starts directly (even through explorer) opens on no screen. The FightCamp buttons run `schtasks /run` on Interactive tasks 'FightCamp Play ...' (Tools/register_play_tasks.ps1), which start the build in his own desktop session; the test jumps ride the task's '-- jump=...' argument (Lean scripts/ui/TestJump.gd).

targets.label: Play FightCamp (latest build)
targets.why: The newest exported build (E:/FightCamp/Lean/Builds), from the title screen. Operator S310: 'add a link on the board to launch the latest version'. Close a running copy first - an export cannot replace the exe while it is open.

targets.label: Test: fight night WITH film study
targets.why: Starts the latest build straight at the part to test: a quick-start career, Lucy's next bout booked, camp with film study, weighed in, fight night open - the shout bar marks the coach's pick from film. Its own save slot; your career save is untouched.

targets.label: Test: fight night WITHOUT film study
targets.why: The same jump with no film study in camp - no coach's pick on the shout bar: read the clue yourself. Its own save slot.

targets.label: Test: the corner minute (recover, set-up, talk)
targets.why: Fight night with film study and two combinations drilled on the pads: after round 1 the corner card has the recover points, a combination set-up and the talk; in round 2 the gold NOW button fires the set-up. Its own save slot.

targets.why: Starts the latest build at the day Lucy can enter the National Amateur Championships (a known career played through its first bouts), on WORLD > Nationals: press Enter, then CONTINUE through the London regional. Its own save slot; your career save is untouched.

Turn her pro, then CONTINUE through her debut camp to the fight; the result page shows the tickets sold. Its own save slot; your career save is untouched.

Lucy's Training tab shows the records wall after the first Sunday. The 3D fight still shows a woman's body for him. Its own save slot.

targets.why: A quick-start career with Lucy booked and two of her own combinations drilled (a jab-cross-lead hook signature and a jab-cross); the jump opens PLAYBOOK > Game plan on the GO-TO COMBINATION row - name one, see the rounds it holds whole, then Continue to fight night. Its own save slot.

targets.label: Claude desktop app
targets.why: The app crashed and the operator is on the phone. Start it here, then type /remote-control in its prompt box to drive this PC from the phone - the CLI route does not exist on this machine (HANDOFF 2026-09-13: `claude` is not on PATH, and it is absent from .local/bin, Programs and npm). LAUNCHED BY AppUserModelID, not by path: Claude is an MSIX package under C:/Program Files/WindowsApps, which is ACL-locked and carries a version that changes on every update. On 2026-09-21 the path search resolved ready=true against a STALE STAGED COPY in WindowsApps.tmp - version 1.8555.1.0 while the installed package was 2.2553.1.0 - so the button would have started an app a year out of date. The candidates below are kept as a fallback for a future non-packaged build.

targets.label: Explorer at the checkout
targets.why: Opens the repo folder on the PC - the quickest way to get at PowerShell, the rebuild command and the task scheduler when the app is down.
